mathematics.assertion_tested: A convex two-polarization model cancels a uniform background in co-shifted equilibria, but its spherical sum mode forbids a decaying isolated solution. Finite-boundary profiles quantify the retained MOND window.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact sympy identities and binary64 scipy boundary value solves
mathematics.conventions: Dimensionless Plummer force f=x/(1+x^2)^(3/2); vector radial Laplacian L u=u''+2u'/x-2u/x^2; eps=.01, reference stiffness K; regular inner Robin and zero outer fields
non_claims: No selection of a reference from cosmological initial conditions
Finite boundaries are physical assumptions, not derived halo edges
